scope: Finite original compatibility requirements; not exhaustive TeX or math coverage. No product support asserted.

cases.authorship: Original fixture authored by Codex for FlashTeX; repository license applies.
assertions: Blackboard glyphs differ from Roman; all 26 capitals resolve; macros preserve scripts, math style, and setminus spacing.

cases.authorship: Original fixture authored by Codex for FlashTeX; repository license applies.
assertions: Each l/c/r column aligns independently; row gaps, vertical rules, cases brace, and suppressed outer column padding match the reference.

cases.authorship: Original fixture authored by Codex for FlashTeX; repository license applies.
assertions: Manual delimiter sizes increase monotonically; automatic and null delimiters work; thin/medium/quad/qquad/negative spaces retain their distinct widths.

cases.authorship: Original fixture authored by Codex for FlashTeX; repository license applies.
assertions: Title sizes and explicit line gaps match; size/weight switches restore after nested groups; center and rule do not leak formatting into body text.

cases.authorship: Original fixture authored by Codex for FlashTeX; repository license applies.
assertions: Zero indentation and 0.65em paragraph gaps apply; local 2em indentation/1.3em gaps restore after group; heading spacing composes with paragraph glue.

cases.authorship: Original fixture authored by Codex for FlashTeX; repository license applies.
assertions: Points labels share a right edge and normal weight; two hfill glues divide available space equally; quote uses its narrowed width and restores body width.
